mapping_policy.Pi: Only source/frozen structural individuation, partition, or boundary support qualifies; physicality is not required.
mapping_policy.X: Only frozen S/state_or_structure support is promoted to X; condition or response labels are not relabeled as X.
mapping_policy.C: Only realizability/admissibility/resource structure qualifies; generic experimental conditions do not.
mapping_policy.Q: Only structurally frozen criterion-conditioned filtering/orientation qualifies; scalarity is not required.
mapping_policy.P_in: Requires frozen evidence that the probe presents, varies, perturbs, or intervenes on an interface setting; old P alone is insufficient.
mapping_policy.P_out: Requires frozen evidence that the probe queries, elicits, measures, or exposes an observation/readout.
mapping_policy.K: Typed transformation/dependence may be relational or stochastic and is not restricted to a mathematical function.
mapping_policy.T: Temporal indexing/order remains distinct from K; precedence alone is not K.
mapping_policy.rho/O: Frozen information/access and response/outcome coordinates may instantiate incoming or outgoing boundary-relative traces; O is not assumed terminal.
mapping_policy.persistence: No identity-like carry is inferred unless explicitly frozen.

supported_relations.grammar_relation: K dependence: environment_change_rate -> outcome_weight
K update: outcome_history changes environment_change_rate and outcome_weight
K dependence/readout: outcome_weight + outcome_history -> next_choice
Q-conditioned evaluation of outcome_weight
P_out probe exposes O(next_choice); probe also supplies a P_in contingency manipulation
T: outcome_history < environment_change_rate; outcome_history < outcome_weight; outcome_weight < next_choice

X.mapping: environment_change_rate and outcome_weight instantiate the frozen S role as configuration carriers.

notes: Changing environmental contingencies are not reclassified as C.

Q.mapping: adaptive_weighting_rule is a source-declared criterion orienting how recent outcomes should be weighted.

P_in.mapping: changing_contingency_probe includes an experimentally varied contingency regime; this is the inward/interface manipulation component.

frozen_value.description: sequential reward task in which contingency stability is experimentally varied
the sequential contingency manipulation exposes trial-by-trial adaptation of decisions

notes: The frozen structure does not require a direct P_in -> X edge; the manipulation and the readout are bundled in one probe.

P_out.mapping: The same probe reads out the subsequent choice.

K.mapping: Non-functional stochastic dependence/update structure links incoming outcomes, inferred change rate, weighting, and choice.

T.mapping: Time index, history window, future horizon, recurrence, and three explicit orderings are frozen.
notes: No persistence/carry is inferred.

rho/O.mapping: outcome_history is incoming available information and next_choice is an outward response/readout; O is therefore not terminal-only.

derived-feature candidates: outcome_weight can be treated as a Q-conditioned K parameter/state feature rather than a new primitive grammar role
history_window, future_horizon, and recurrence are T refinements
environment_change_rate remains X/S structure; volatility is not evidence for C
notes: BLF01 independently supports simultaneous T and K; the temporal sequence is not being used as the sole evidence for transformation.

notes: The temporal order itself is not treated as K; r2/r3 independently supply K.

derived-feature candidates: discrepancy_magnitude is a derived K quantity from X and O_in, not a new primitive role
desirable/undesirable classes are a Q-induced partition candidate, but primitive Pi remains absent

no persistence/carry relation is inferred from the repeated estimates
notes: The revised estimate is frozen as O rather than a second S/X coordinate; Grammar v0 can represent the claim as a readout of the post-update configuration without inventing a frozen X_{t+1} node.

grammar distinctions required by BLF: K must remain a typed relation/dependence, not only a deterministic X->X function; BLF04 has K-like dependence with no explicit X coordinate.
P must remain directionally factorizable: a single frozen probe can contain a P_in manipulation/presentation and a P_out measurement/readout.
rho/O must admit both incoming information/access and outgoing response/readout; it cannot mean terminal output only.
Q must cover adaptive relevance rules, stopping thresholds, logical correctness criteria, selectivity criteria, and reference-relative categorical valence without requiring a scalar.
Pi must allow classificatory/experimental partitions; BLF05 does not require a physical boundary.
T must remain separable from K; BLF02 and BLF06 have explicit ordering while separate relations provide the K evidence.
Null-axis experimental condition nodes may be retained as typed P_in parameters or Pi members when structural probe/partition evidence supports that placement; they are not automatically C.
roles not needed by BLF: C is not instantiated by any BLF claim.
No single BLF claim requires all Grammar v0 roles.
Primitive persistence/carry is not needed anywhere in BLF.
possible compression / derived-feature c: BLF01 outcome weighting is a Q-conditioned K feature over T rather than a separate primitive.
BLF02 matched-association structure is a typed P_in setting/context parameter rather than C.
BLF03 speed-accuracy tradeoff is derived from Q-conditioned K/rho over T; the bound is Q rather than C.
BLF04 validity and believability are factorial P_in settings; their interaction is K-level structure over O.
BLF05 selectivity is Q over rho/O indexed by Pi classes.
BLF06 discrepancy magnitude and update amount are derived relational quantities; Q may induce a desirable/undesirable classification without requiring primitive Pi.

potential threats to Grammar v0.detail: BLF02/03/04 use essential frozen condition nodes with no old basis axis. They fit only if typed P_in operations may carry controlled input/settings. A narrower P_in definition would leave residuals.

potential threats to Grammar v0.threat: Overly narrow K as X->X transition only
potential threats to Grammar v0.detail: BLF04 requires typed dependence from probe settings to O without an explicit X coordinate. The current Grammar v0 definition explicitly permits typed dependence; narrowing K to a state-update function would fail BLF04.
BLF01/02/03/06 contain frozen incoming information O coordinates as well as outgoing response O coordinates.
BLF Q instances include an adaptive weighting rule, threshold/stopping criterion, logical necessity criterion, selectivity criterion, and reference-relative categorical valence rule.

lane_summary.counterexample_statement: No BLF01-BLF06 frozen structure requires a new primitive beyond Grammar v0 when typed P_in parameters and relational K are interpreted as already allowed by #321. No frozen residual remains.
